==Description==
The '''Shock Ducky''' is one of the five duckies spawned by the [[Ducky Squad]] consumable. It has a low amount of health and creates an explosion upon death.

Upon death, the '''Shock Ducky''' will create an explosion which deals 100 damage to all enemies hit in its explosion radius of 6. This explosion can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, bypasses defense and has no damage drop off. Any enemy hit by the explosion will also have shock applied to them, which stuns the enemy for 3 seconds.

==Appearance==
The '''Shock Ducky''' is a regular yellow duck with black eyes, orange beak and orange flippers. It wears a yellow cap and grey shades. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared.

==Strategy==
*The '''Shock Ducky''' can be used to stall enemies quite well, though do note that any enemy with the [[Stun Immunity]] will be only slowed down instead of fully stunned.
*The '''Shock Ducky''' can be used to deal with weaker hordes of enemies, as it deals decent splash damage.
